test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A swimmer can swim at a speed of 12 km/h in still water. If a river is flowing at a speed of 2 km/h, then how much time will the swimmer take to swim 6 km upstream?
solution:
Formula:

D = S × T

Effective upstream speed = x – y, Where

x = Speed of swimmer, y = Speed of river

D = Distance in km, S
